releases.name: AbyssME 0.8.0 Beta 1
releases.body:
AbyssME now brings 24 platforms together on ARM64. The new platform gallery lets you pick a device and browse its games. Turn on **Show platforms without games** to find a new system, install its firmware if needed, and add your first game.

Alongside Java ME, Mophun, Symbian and N-Gage, the ARM64 edition includes WIPI / SKVM, Dingoo A320, Gemei A330, Aquaplus P/ECE, Watara Supervision, Mega Duck, Cybiko, Flash Lite, Gamate, Palm OS, Palm webOS, Firefox OS, KaiOS, Atari Portfolio, early iPhone OS, Arduboy / FX, Gamebuino Classic, Pokitto, original Thumby and ESPboy. The ARMv7 edition includes Java ME and Mophun.

**Download** the standard APK for ARM64 or the APK marked **armv7** for a 32-bit ARM device. Both require Android 10 or later. Install over the previous official APK to keep your games and saves. Supply your own games and system files.

[Setup guide](https://abysstail.art/guides/abyssme-setup.html) · [Source and build instructions](https://github.com/EriArk/JavaEmulator/blob/v0.8.0-beta.1/docs/releases/v0.8.0-beta.1.md)

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 10

Beta 10 adds **global physical-controller profiles** and improves Mophun sound and game speed.

Open **Settings → Physical controller profiles** to edit the global mapping or create reusable profiles for buttons and both sticks. Assign them to games from the manager or each game's Controls page. Graphics, touch layouts and physical mappings stay independent. Existing per-game overrides take priority; shared changes apply the next time the game opens. Profiles are included in library backups.

Mophun sound is now enabled for every game. Short BEEP effects and `vBeep` are supported, and PCM follows pause and emulation speed. A common phone-model execution budget reduces excessive speed in CPU-dependent games such as the supplied Boulder Dash and Lemtris versions.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.10-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place. Back up important saves before updating or switching architecture. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 9
releases.body:
Beta 9 adds **independent right-stick mapping** for physical controllers.

Open **Controls → Controller mapping → Sticks** to assign the right stick’s directions and diagonals to phone keys, soft keys or Fire. **Identify** detects right-stick movement; pressing R3 remains a separate input. Bindings are saved per game, and existing profiles keep their settings with the new directions unbound.

The shared input path supports Java ME, Mophun and Symbian/N-Gage. This maps stick directions to digital keys; it does not add proportional analog camera support to games.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and experimental Symbian/N-Gage.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.9-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Android 10+ is required. Both update the existing app in place.

Tested with automated input and a virtual joystick on Retroid; physical dual-stick hardware testing remains pending. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 8
releases.body:
Beta 8 fixes Lara's black/striped appearance and loading-screen text showing through her model in **Tomb Raider: Underworld 3D**. The cause was incorrect transparency when transferring M3G rendering to the Java ME screen.

Startup errors now show the original game exception instead of only `InvocationTargetException`.

- **ARM64:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8.apk` — Java ME, Mophun and the combined Symbian runtime.
- **ARMv7:** `AbyssME-0.7.0-beta.8-armv7.apk` — Java ME and Mophun, without Symbian.

Both require Android 10+ and update the existing app without uninstalling.

The reported **Crash Titans 1.3.7 Sony S700i JAR** was also checked. Its code and packed resources are inconsistent; the same reader fails on ordinary Java outside AbyssME. This release does not make that particular JAR playable.

Checks: 427 JVM tests per build, focused Retroid renderer tests, signed APK update and first-room checks. This is not complete-game acceptance. Source bundles and SHA-256 checksums are included.

releases.name: AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7
releases.body:
# AbyssME 0.7.0 Beta 7

## Separate graphics and control profiles

- **Settings → Graphics profiles** and **Settings → Control profiles** now have
  independent global defaults, named profiles and assignments. Each game can
  select one graphics profile and one control profile. Changing or resetting
  one category leaves the other intact; extra Gamepad buttons remain available.
- Graphics profiles include supported scaling, smoothing, built-in xBRZ/CRT,
  FSR/sharpness, interpolation, LCD filters and capture settings. Java GPU and
  Mophun support GPU effects; Symbian uses its supported host display options.
  Integer scaling falls back to Fit on Symbian. Java-only geometry options are
  identified in the editor's support information.
- Beta 6 combined profiles split automatically: LCD inheritance and exceptions
  move to graphics, while touch settings remain in controls. Other existing
  graphics remain explicit overrides. Reset the relevant category's overrides
  when you want existing games to inherit a shared setup.
- Both catalogs, including unassigned profiles, travel through library backups.
  Phone backups retain portable game definitions. Picture Keep/Undo preserves

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.body:
It is my pleasure to announce a new version of Hades!

There's a ton of new and exciting features on this one, I'm happy it's finally landing in your hands 😁. 

Among others, this release provides:

## **Highlights**:
- **Cheat code support**:  with all three major cheat devices: GameShark, CodeBreaker and Pro Action Replay v3 (PARv3)
- **xBRZ scaling filter**, for sharp, smooth visuals at high resolutions
- **Idle loop elimination**, to boost the performances of some of your favorite games

## **Emulation**:
- **ROM Mirroring support**, which fixes a bunch of input issues in the Classic NES Series games
- **OBJ rendering cycle limits**: sprites now have a per-scanline rendering budget, like the real PPU
- **PSG channels 2 and 3** are now resampled correctly each time their frequency changes
- **New color correction profiles** based on the work of Pokefan531 and Hunterk

## **Performance**:
- The scheduler now uses a **min-heap** to find the next event faster, giving a significant performance boost
- **Link-time optimizations (LTO)** are now enabled by default for release builds
- Fixed a performance issue when a file dialog was open

### Español
- **Soporte para 2 mandos locales en Android:** Jugador 1 y Jugador 2 independientes por `InputDevice` ID (`read_pad` / `read_pad2`) con detección automática de conexión/desconexión vía JNI.

- **Diagonales en mando físico y reflejos:** Zona muerta radial 2D para alcanzar el 100% en diagonales y `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.

---

### English
- **2-player local controller support on Android:** Independent P1/P2 mapping by `InputDevice` ID (`read_pad` / `read_pad2`) with automatic connect/disconnect tracking.
- **Android 10 (API 29) crash fix:** Guarded `InsetsController` behind API >= 30 with safe legacy immersive fallback.
- **Physical stick diagonals & cubemaps:** 2D radial deadzone for full 100% diagonal reach and `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` on square `6n`-layer `2D_ARRAY` images.

releases.name: v0.3.7: Battle cut-ins & two-sided stencil rendering fix
releases.body:
## Persona 4 Arena Ultimax for Android v0.3.7

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Battle Cut-ins Missing Fixed (Fixes #4):**
  Fixed missing special move, super attack, and Persona summon cut-in portraits and animations in battle.
  - Implemented proper two-sided stencil dynamic state (reference, compare mask, and write mask).
  - Added support for \VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT\ and \VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM_S8_UINT\ in dynamic rendering pipelines, enabling stencil writes on all mobile GPUs.
  - Added state invalidation on pass end (\g_bound = Bound{}\) so dynamic stencil state is correctly bound in every render pass.
  *Se corrigió la ausencia de los cut-ins de personajes, ataques especiales e invocaciones de Persona en combate. Se reparó el estado dinámico de stencil de doble cara, el soporte para formatos D24S8/D16S8 en Dynamic Rendering y la invalidación de estado al terminar pases.*

Install over the previous version; your saves and data stay. / Instálalo encima de la versión anterior; tus partidas y datos se mantienen.

### Geração de quadros experimental

releases.name: Def Jam v1.3 — Discord, Voice & Controls Update
releases.body:
Def Jam v1.3 brings Discord account integration, room discovery corrections, voice chat, refreshed menus and restored custom analog controls to the Android ARM64 port.

## Online and Discord
- Sign in through the official FFNY Online Discord account service. New connections use the verified account name; the manual player-name screen is removed.
- Saved sessions use encrypted app-private storage. Account sign-out, deletion and privacy controls remain accessible inside the game.
- Fixed the PC build fingerprint used for ordinary room and player discovery. The missing build-number bytes previously separated Android players from compatible PC lobbies.
- Choose Europe or North America from the launcher. Both players must use the same region.
- Added real account statistics and leaderboard access in the native online menu.
- Preserved room codes, native room creation, fighter selection and the existing online flow.

## Room voice chat
- Added PC-compatible room voice with push-to-talk: enable voice, allow microphone access and hold MIC to speak.
- Added a microphone permission prompt on first game entry, playback volume and a Mute/Unmute microphone button.

releases.name: Def Jam v1.2 — Controls & Compatibility Update
releases.body:
Update for the Android ARM64 port, focused on controls, frame pacing and online compatibility.

## Changes since v1.1
- Expanded Xbox/PlayStation-style and custom touch control layouts, including dual analog input and editable menu buttons.
- Improved the online player-name prompt and retained the original in-game online menu with room codes. Removed the extra floating ONLINE shortcut; Enter/Start is retained.
- Updated automatic 60 FPS menu / 30 FPS low-end combat pacing, frame-time statistics and CPU/network diagnostics. Actual performance depends on the device and scene.
- Reduced repeated missing-file lookups and refined online input waiting and delay handling.
- Updated the public relay connection handshake and corrected misleading password errors and repeated connection attempts after rejection.
- Included experimental, opt-in rollback support. It is not certified for stable cross-device play and respects the relay's rollback permission.

Existing saves, the built-in ISO/XISO extractor, gamepad support, English/Portuguese/Spanish interfaces and asynchronous Vulkan rendering are retained.

## Important online notice

releases.name: xbased 1.2.15
releases.body:
## 1.2.15 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Games that read the picture they are drawing as a texture, as Riddick's
  lighting does about 150 times a frame, no longer copy the whole picture
  before each of those draws. The picture is read where it is drawn. The
  copies weigh most on cards with little memory speed: in Escape from
  Butcher Bay a GTX 1050 at 2x dropped to 35-50 fps, and a fast card at 6x
  went from 50 to 60 fps in the same scene (#435).

### Fixes
- Chronicles of Riddick froze a few seconds into a new game, and in some
  later chapters, on slower graphics cards since 1.2.14. The emulator let a
  game run further ahead of the graphics card than an Xbox does, and Riddick
  ended up with more visibility tests waiting than it has room for. Now a
  game is at most a frame ahead of what the card has drawn, as on the
  console. A card that keeps up never waits (#435).

  again, since 1.2.0 (#287). When a vertex program writes no fog, the Xbox's
  graphics chip uses the fog its earlier vertices left (it keeps the last 6),
  and xbased gave those vertices no fog distance, so the city's haze coloured

releases.name: xbased 1.2.14
releases.body:
## 1.2.14 (2026-11)

### Performance
- Scenes made of many small pieces run much faster. A game that draws lots
  of small triangle strips one after another has them drawn as one, and each
  draw uploads only the shader constants it uses. 007 Everything or
  Nothing's first level, looking at the courtyard, went from 38 to about 135
  fps uncapped on a fast PC, and at Original it now holds 30 where it
  dropped to 13 (#429).
- Interrupts reach the emulated CPU with a single memory write instead of a
  call into Windows, which made every game's interrupts cheaper.
- Uncapped games that show a frame every second vblank no longer wait on
  Windows' timer between the two, which can't wait less than half a
  millisecond.
- Unlocked on a 120 Hz or faster display (VRR or not): a frame that comes
  late is shown at once instead of waiting for the display's next refresh.

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: Spyro A Hero's Tail ran at 64.5 fps at Up to 60. The
  limit followed a vsync grid that slowly moved back, and the display's
  refresh period could be measured as a fraction of the real one. Frames are
  now counted against the display's refreshes (#430).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.13
releases.body:
## 1.2.13 (2026-11)

A cleanup and optimization release: the same emulator, with less code.

### Changes
- The code is cleaned of everything that no longer served: the paths for
  platforms xbased doesn't run on, the workarounds for graphics drivers no PC
  has, old files, and functions nothing called any more. About 8,000 lines of
  code less, the executable a little smaller, and nothing that changes how
  games run.
- Depth buffers are created only with the uses they have, which leaves the
  driver more room to compress them.
- The debug switches (props.ini) are read by one piece of code on Windows and
  Linux alike.
- The source repository is tidier: README, BUILDING and CHANGELOG at its root,
  the build steps in one place, and every library built in listed with its
  license.

### Fixes
- The Linux build compiles without warnings on Ubuntu 22.04 (a few
  declarations its C library doesn't have).

releases.name: xbased 1.2.12
releases.body:
## 1.2.12 (2026-11)

### New
- Downsampling (Settings > Video > Downsampling: Off, 1x, 2x, 4x): the game
  is drawn at the internal resolution, then the picture is averaged down to
  the console's own resolution, or twice or four times it, before it's scaled
  to your screen. Smooth edges with the original look. It needs an internal
  resolution above the size chosen, and works with FXAA, FSR and the CRT look
  (#427).

### Fixes
- Fable The Lost Chapters: the hero's hair could turn into streaks up close
  after some area loads, until the next restart. The game builds the hero's
  look into a cache on the hard disk at each load, and a piece of it drawn
  where a swizzled texture of the same size had been landed in the wrong
  pixel order (#380).
- Savestates: a state made from a .chd loads from an .iso of the same dump
  and the other way round, and a state that is refused says why in the log.
- Frame rate limit: with the GPU maxed out (a high internal resolution on a
  laptop) the frame rate could drift above the limit, 64 fps at Up to 60 in
  Crash Bandicoot The Wrath of Cortex. The moments the presenter picks frames

releases.name: xbased 1.2.11
releases.body:
## 1.2.11 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- Frame rate limit: games that keep three frames ready, like Crash Bandicoot
  The Wrath of Cortex, could go over the limit on a busy PC (64-65 fps at
  Up to 60 on a laptop). Right after a frame went through, a second one could
  be let through a millisecond later before the emulated GPU had moved on
  (#411).
- Games that flip in their own interrupt handler, like Star Wars Republic
  Commando, went about one frame a second over the limit (61 fps at Up to 60):
  a frame they flipped outside that handler didn't count against it.

releases.name: v0.1.14
releases.body:
Smoother frame pacing, fewer hitches, a new frame counter.

## English

**Improvements**
- Less work per frame on the CPU side: the Vulkan commands are now recorded on a separate thread.
- Fewer missing objects or flicker for a moment while a new effect or area is seen for the first time.
- With the frame rate limit at 30, the screen switches to 60 Hz, so frames come out evenly. The limit in the ⚙ menu now applies right away, without a restart.

- Better rendering with the phone's own (system) Vulkan driver on Adreno.
- The frame counter is now a small separate overlay with a dot that shows when the phone is getting hot and slowing down. Long-press the counter to see what the dot means.
- More detail in the log if the graphics driver crashes, to help fix such reports.

releases.name: Eglantine Build 26/11/2026
releases.body:
Automatic daily build of `nx2-experimental` at `ed46267`.

## Changes since the previous daily build

39 commits since the 25/11 build. The big one is a rewrite of how ASTC textures are recompressed for Vulkan; the rest are game fixes, archive handling and recovery paths.

### Graphics — ASTC recompression is now a single pass ([#951](https://github.com/Eglantine-Community/Eglantine/pull/951))

Compressed textures no longer make a detour through a temporary RGBA8 image (decode → round trip through memory → encode). The BC1/BC3 blocks are written straight from the ASTC blocks the invocation touches, in one dispatch.

- **Much less memory moved** (`eb459b4118`). On Mario Kart World the old path held 236–851 MiB resident and pushed 74–657 MiB/s through it, over 33–180 transcodes a second. Now nothing but the blocks is written, so the decode image, its second dispatch, the barrier between them and the 64 MiB layer chunking are all gone.
- **Faster where it counts** (`3a1ce9cb1b`). An 8×8 footprint — the one these titles ship — used to decode each block up to four times over; it is one invocation per ASTC block now. A 1024×1024 level measures 2.1 ms instead of 5.2 ms on a GT 1030.

## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.2 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.1 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

- On the front of a building, letting go of Circle throws the punch. With the upgrade, even a quick press charged
  all the way into the double punch. As in the original, letting go early gives the single punch, and holding on
  gives the double punch.

Thanks to the player who reported this.

releases.name: RampageRE v1.2.4
releases.body:
RampageRE v1.2.4

Buildings falling by themselves, grabbing and eating, and a few smaller things from the same report.

- Buildings no longer collapse out of nowhere at the start of a city's boss block. In a city played for more than
  eight minutes, the block's time-up airstrike went off as the boss block began, and its bombers flattened the
  tallest towers before you touched them. As in the original, the boss block has no time-up airstrike.
- Nick and Edwin (Dick on the PS2) can grab people and cars. They are the only two monsters without the hand point
  the grab looked for, and came up empty every time.
- What a monster holds hangs from its fist the way the original's does, instead of sinking into the hand. The
  monsters that toss their food into the mouth (Lizzie, Ralph, Leon, Rojo, Wally, Edwin and the others on their
  skeleton) throw people up and into their mouths again.
- Picking up an upgrade says UPGRADE. Taken while a challenge's banner was still up, it showed a red RAMPAGE.
- The singer with the guitar in Las Vegas is heard again after the first time through his song. It went quiet for
  good; as in the original, it starts over when you come back near him.

releases.name: RampageRE v1.2.3
releases.body:
RampageRE v1.2.3

The keyboard's controls, and keys that left the game.

- In a game started from the menus, the number keys, N, M, G and Page Up / Page Down no longer change the city, the
  time of day, the monster or the block. They are the developer build's city viewer keys and had stayed on in the
  game, where a stray press threw you out of the level you were playing.
- The README now lists the keyboard's controls. On the keyboard you punch with J, kick with K and grab with L (Space
  jumps, R roars, W A S D move, the arrows turn the head, P, Enter or Esc pause); a controller plays too.

Thanks to the player who reported it.

jjmhalew-rampagere.latest_body:
RampageRE v1.2.8

The order of a frame, the monsters' moves and the bot partner, checked frame by frame against the original game.

- A frame runs in the original's order: every monster picks its next move first, then the monsters move, then the
  people, the traffic and the buildings, then the monsters' blows on each other. A kick on the bot partner now
  lands on the same frame as in the original, and its reaction starts a frame sooner.
- A move that blends into the next one keeps the old move going for 2 more frames before the new one takes over,
  as in the original. Its animation starts at once, as before; a press during those 2 frames picks from the old
  move, as the original does.
- The monster turns towards the stick one frame later, as in the original. Walks and turns now follow the original's
  path.
- A monster walking or knocked into a building front is held off it before it picks its next move. It used to end
  up inside the front for a frame.
- A walk that turns into a punch stops where it is, and a punch that ends in the idle pose no longer slides the
  monster back a little. The idle after a punch now stands where the original's does.

releases.name: 1.0.0 Risshun
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

### Two sync modes:
- **Rollback** — save-state resimulation for near-zero input lag, ideal for fighting games and fast action titles. Boot is fully deterministic (RTC, samplerate, disk/NVRAM state pinned), so only inputs ever cross the network — nothing bulky to transfer at connect time.
- **Lockstep** — simple guaranteed sync for titles where rollback doesn't apply cleanly.

releases.body:
**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

- **Faster gameplay.** Eleven engine optimisations that were only switched on during development are now on for everyone. releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
The Sims 2 for Android **0.3.1-dev** improves Lua error handling, material creation, renderer diagnostics, texture conversion, and the launcher. Changes since **0.3-dev**, from signed source commit `a84f6585caca7a90afe140540714f879800c33bb`.

One APK includes **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The minimum requirements are now **Android 8.0 (API 26)** and **OpenGL ES 3.1**; the native Vulkan renderer accepts **Vulkan 1.0**. Game data must come from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. Android 8.0–8.1 and GLES 3.1-only devices still need further device testing.

## Stability and startup

- Fixed the embedded MSVC `setjmp/longjmp` implementation used by Lua: returning to an error handler now unwinds the actual native call stack as well as restoring guest state. The bridge covers all 34 original setjmp call sites and both longjmp epilogues.
- Handle nested and repeated Lua errors, restore exception state, and remove jump contexts when their function returns, a C++ handler unwinds past them, or their thread ends. A jump to a function that has already returned is diagnosed.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
One APK now supports both **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The port requires Android 10 or later, OpenGL ES 3.2, and game data from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. ARM32 also requires Thumb-2, NEON, and 4 KiB kernel pages. Android chooses the ABI, and the app unpacks the matching XZ-compressed engine on first use.

## Graphics and performance

- Fixed flickering and missing objects on Mali-G51 in OpenGL ES. The workaround defaults to on and can be changed in Advanced renderer settings. Fixed a related driver hang reproduced on Mali-T830.
- OpenGL ES compiles and links uncached shader programs in the background, reducing stalls when zooming out, rotating the camera, or changing floors.
- The in-game **Minimal Graphics** preset lowers 11 settings to reduce memory use. It saves the previous values, persists across restarts, and restores those values when switched off.
- **Android performance hints (ADPF) are off by default.** The launcher still lets you turn them on for the next game start.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.2-dev

- **Vulkan textures.** DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 now use the correct BC formats on drivers that support them. This fixes colored noise on terrain, roads, and trees seen on Adreno 735 with both the system Vulkan driver and Turnip.
- **OpenGL ES.** Fixed dynamic buffer updates that could corrupt neighborhood chooser panels and text on Adreno 650 and 735, and the neighborhood HUD on Adreno 650.
- **Vulkan UI scaling.** The APK now includes precompiled SPIR-V variants for FSR 1 UI scaling for all 81 pixel shader entries and the built-in fixed-function pixel shader. Shaders outside the library, including shaders used by some mods, can still be compiled on the device.
- **Shader coverage.** The bundled library grew from 194 to 380 captured shaders and from 215 to 408 entries, including sampler variants. The updated capture tool checks bytecode hashes and records sampler variants. A strict diagnostic mode and a library format check help verify coverage.

## Install or update

Download the APK below or check for updates in the launcher. This build supports ARM64 devices running Android 10 or later and requires compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection game files.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.1.2-dev

- **Graphics.** The port's own OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan 1.1 renderers handle Direct3D 9 calls. OpenGL ES is the default. Vulkan supports the system driver, bundled Turnip or PanVK on compatible devices, and imported drivers. DXVK has been removed.
- **Graphics settings.** Both renderers support render scaling, FXAA, MSAA, FSR 1 for the scene and interface, and the launcher’s ETC2 and ASTC texture cache. Existing FSR 3.1 selections switch to FSR 1.
- **PowerVR performance.** OpenGL ES buffer handling reduces severe frame-rate drops on affected PowerVR devices.
- **Lower-latency audio.** The game's EA SND mixer outputs directly to Android AAudio. DirectSound emulation has been removed.
- **Mods folder.** The launcher shows the folder for .package mods and lets you copy its path. Mods in subfolders are supported.
- **Touch input.** The on-screen keyboard opens when you tap previously blocked text fields, including pet names.
- **Loading screens.** Startup captions and town and lot loading animations follow the original game timing.

## Install or update

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.4-beta
releases.body:
Fifth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.
- **Touches beside the on-screen buttons acted as a mouse**, a second input device for the game. The touch controls are the only player-1 input now (a real mouse or keyboard still works once used).

### Performance and heat
- **Built-in Turnip updated to Mesa 26.3** with our patch for importing the game's memory directly (no per-draw copies). If you picked another driver in *Settings → GPU driver*, switch back to **Built-in**: drivers without this import copy memory on every draw.

releases.name: PvZ: Replanted Android v0.1.3-beta
releases.body:
Fourth beta of the Android port of the PS5 version of **Plants vs. Zombies: Replanted** (AnyPS5 + Box64 + Turnip). Installs over earlier betas, game data and settings are kept.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

### Fixes
- **Missing graphics and crashes on scene changes** (starting a level, the money bag at the end of a level): results the GPU writes back into game memory were silently skipped on pages the driver's write tracking had protected, so the game read stale or zero data. Menu elements that never showed up before (e.g. the Co-op / Vs. tombstone) are back.
- "storage texture has no committed guest pages" crash.

### Performance and heat
- Draw recipes now work for the menu (repeated draws reuse their recorded setup).
- Box64 spin-waits sleep (`PAUSE=3`, WFE) instead of spinning: less CPU load for the same frame rate.
- The driver's two threads wake each other only when one actually waits.

### Requirements
- Adreno (Snapdragon) GPU only; Android 11+ recommended. Tested on Snapdragon 8 Elite.

- Strong heating during long sessions → the phone lowers its clocks and FPS drops. For long sessions use the **45 FPS** limit.
- The menu is slower than levels (the driver is still single-threaded).
- A rare crash while a level loads — just restart.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. releases.body:
# 宝可梦传说 Z‑A 安卓移植 · Mali 零拷贝修复版（宿主 APK）

**这是一个“宿主”APK：只含移植运行时，不含任何游戏数据、NSO、资源或密钥。**
运行它需要你**自备自己游戏卡带/数字版的转储**，并用 [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android)
的 porter 生成数据包（步骤见仓库 README 的「怎么用」与「自备文件与公开性」）。

## 这版修了什么（Mali‑G925 上 3 FPS → 30 FPS）

- **根因**：MTK（MT6991）的 gralloc 给 `AHardwareBuffer` 的 native handle 有 3 个 fd，
  `fd[0]` 是 size 0 的只读元数据文件，`fd[1]` 才是 dma-buf（`st_size == 缓冲区大小`）。
  上游恒取 `fds[0]` 去 `mmap`，于是这台 Mali 上 771 MB 的 NVN 内存池**全部**退回
  “每提交整池双向 memcpy”，每帧约 375 ms——这正是帧时间的大头。
- **修法**：`ahb_buf_fd()` 按 `fstat().st_size == 池大小` 选出真正的 dma-buf fd；
  `pool_zero_copy()` 与 `vk_pool_remap_ro()` 都改用它。补丁全文：
  [`patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch`](https://github.com/Timqt/pokelegza-and/blob/main/patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch)
- **实测**（25079RPDCC，Dimensity 9400 级，Mali‑G925‑Immortalis MC12，Vulkan 1.3.278）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 零拷贝内存池 | 0 / 771 MB | **771.2 / 771.2 MB** |
| 菜单 FPS | 2–3 | **30**（游戏自身 present interval 上限） |
| 帧工作 p50 | 343 ms | **16.9 ms** |
| submit+present | 53–82 ms | 3–4.5 ms |

- 已能从语言选择一路进到开场列车场景（字幕 “Your train has arrived in Lumiose
  City!”）。当前瓶颈是 GPU 渲染（场景内约 20–25 ms，≈48 FPS 上限）。

## 使用

uncharted-android 0.3.7 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: dumps made with Itemzflow now prepare and play. The app takes executables that are already decrypted (plain ELF files), and Itemzflow's update folder. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **A dump made with Itemzflow stopped at Preparing with `eboot.bin: expected PS4 SELF` (#40).** Itemzflow writes the executables already decrypted, as plain ELF files without the SELF wrapper. The app now takes those as well (eboot.bin, the two .elf files, libc.prx and libSceFios2.prx), as uncharted_pc does since its #498. - **Itemzflow's update folder is found.** `<game folder>-patch` next to the game folder (for example `CUSA02320-patch` next to `CUSA02320`) now counts as the update folder, like `<game folder>-UPDATE`. Choose the game folder and press Prepare: the launcher names the update folder it uses.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.6 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.6 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: upstream uncharted_pc 0.3.15 is merged (Uncharted 3's Load Game hang and fixes for checkpoint loads and textures), a rare crash of Uncharted 1 is fixed, Uncharted 3 gains about 1 FPS without the frame rate limit, and the GPU skinning checks its own inputs, so the rare GPU fault storms can no longer start there. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 1 could close now and then in play.** On the Retroid Pocket G2 this happened about once in three hours without the frame rate limit. A job of the game's scene update read an object whose two fields the game's other code had not filled yet. The update now waits up to about 1.6 ms for them, and if they are still empty it skips the one query that needs them; the game does not use that query's result. In a test that skipped the query every time for two minutes, the game played on unharmed.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.5 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.5 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's spider rooms run at full speed (chapter 7 ran at 10-15 FPS on the Retroid Pocket G2), a rare hang or crash of Uncharted 3 is fixed, and the app now says what is wrong with a copy of the game instead of crashing or stalling without a word. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: the rooms with the spider swarm ran at 10-15 FPS** - chapter 7, "Stay in the Light", and the swarm's return in chapter 11; on the Retroid Pocket G2 at 1280x720 the room now holds the 30 FPS limit (15.0 and 13.2 FPS before, 30.0 and 30.0 after, in two pairs of runs). One pixel shader of the swarm's material picks values from a small table by an index. The translated shader chose among all 84 of its registers at each of twelve such reads, more than the shader compiler of an Adreno has registers for, so it kept values in memory: 52 ms of GPU time a frame for a small part of the screen. The reads are now limited to the table (0.5 ms a frame); the picture is the same

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.4 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.4 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's desert chapters are drawn right - Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were stretched across the screen, on every device. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were drawn as stretched triangles** (#35). The port runs the game's many small skinning jobs in batches, and that code knew one vertex layout for each of the game's skinning shaders. From chapter 16 on the game has a second one (32-bit normals and tangents) for the models with cloth or morph targets - Drake's desert outfit, the horses' blankets and reins - and the batch wrote those vertices at the wrong places. It reads the layout of every job now and batches both; a layout it does not know goes the ordinary way and is named in the log. - **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

Built from nx2 at `00f580a94b3e368b1502727e98cdd6ad80b000cf`.

### Game fixes

- Fix the build 366 boot regression in Pokémon Pokopia 2.0.1 when the NUP stores the executable only in the update. [#2362](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2362)
- Fix the Windows file-lock error that aborts Ori and the Will of the Wisps when it replaces a Spirit Trial ghost. Adapted from xbzk's Eden patch. [#2420](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2420)
- Fix horizontal black bands on Final Fantasy Resonance battle sprites on GPUs without native 24-bit depth support, including AMD. [#2421](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2421)
- Stop some Ocarina of Time walls and floors from sampling the wrong textures while preserving Switch Sports Resort scenery. Ported from kraibse. [#2384](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2384)
- Fix an Ocarina of Time hang caused by interleaved GPU commands. Ported from kraibse. [#2415](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2415)
- Restore missing gloom on terrain and scenery in Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment. Ported from Rhys Denno (@rdenno). [#2416](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2416)

## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.

## Changes since build 386

Built from nx2 at `fdc7cdaf8df179775685d0afb57fca178f876a51`.

Players reported better performance in parts of Ocarina of Time and Donkey Kong Bananza, and smoother crowds in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Gains vary by scene, hardware, and settings.

### Game fixes

- Fix a launch crash in Kirby and the Forgotten Land's Nintendo Switch 2 Edition on affected AMD GPUs. Lichii restores geometry bindings if Vulkan starts a new command buffer while preparing a draw. [#2539](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2539)
- Fix black or incorrectly colored terrain and objects in Ocarina of Time on NVIDIA GTX 10-series and older cards using NVIDIA's driver. The first launch after updating may take longer while the driver rebuilds its shader cache. [#2542](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2542)
- Correct the color grading in Xenoblade Chronicles 2 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by reading its 3D color lookup textures in the layout the game requests. Based on work by LukeWarnut and Mcm190. [#2435](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/2435)

releases.name: Rayman Origins PC Recomp 1.0 (Android)
releases.body:
Rayman Origins (PC, 1.0.32504) recompilado para rodar nativo no Android (arm64). Requer a sua própria cópia da Steam.

**Como instalar**
1. Instale o APK.
2. Em **Arquivos do jogo**, escolha a pasta do jogo da Steam (com `Rayman Origins.exe` e `GameData`) ou um `.zip` dela.
3. Na primeira vez, o launcher cria a cópia leve do jogo (cerca de 1 minuto num S23). Depois disso, toque em **Jogar**.

**Novidades**
- **Cópia leve:** o jogo passa de 2,4 GB para cerca de 0,6 GB. Os sons ficam em Opus; o resto dos arquivos volta idêntico ao original.
- **Importação por .zip:** aceita o `.zip` do jogo completo ou o da cópia leve. O da cópia leve entra direto, sem comprimir de novo.
- **Menu dentro do jogo (engrenagem):** tem as mesmas opções do launcher, editor de posição dos botões e volta ao launcher.
- **Botões de toque:** chegam ao jogo como um controle de Xbox. A pausa e o menu do port são botões separados.
- **Dicas na tela:** mostram as bolinhas A/B/X/Y, RT etc. no lugar das teclas.
- **Gráficos:** Direct3D 9 via DXVK (Vulkan) e suporte a ultrawide.

**Limitações conhecidas**
- A dica "[Delete] Delete file" ainda aparece como texto.
